source_review_summary: Worker-6 re-opened XML/PDF mechanism sections and figure captions. Direct mechanism is limited to LTA binding plus SYTOX/DiSC3(5) membrane assays; simulation and biofilm phenotypes are not over-promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: [Arg8, 15]BH2L and [Lys7, 8]BH2L are supported as binding/interacting with Gram-positive lipoteichoic acid by BC displacement assay context; BH2L is retained as comparator.
limitations: Binding is not a residue-level structure or affinity constant; source text frames relative binding compared with melittin.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BH2L, [Arg8, 15]BH2L, and [Lys7, 8]BH2L show membrane permeabilization and depolarization activity against tested MRSA strains; [Arg8, 15]BH2L is stronger than [Lys7, 8]BH2L in the permeabilization result text.

entity_scope.target_scope: MRSA BAA 1707, BAA 1766, B038 V1S1 A, B042 V2E1 D

limitations: Assays demonstrate membrane functional disruption but do not identify a single protein target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular-dynamics simulations support interaction of BH2L and selected analogues with a bacterial membrane model and membrane-order/density disruption; this remains computational support, not standalone direct biological mechanism evidence.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=35:Simulation of Peptides Interacting with Bacterial Lipid Membrane; xml:table=7; xml:fig=9; xml:fig=10

limitations: Simulation used a model membrane and should not be promoted to direct in vitro target validation.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: [Arg8, 15]BH2L and [Lys7, 8]BH2L inhibit/eradicate MRSA BAA 1707 biofilms and kill persister cells in source text; this is retained as phenotype-supported antibiofilm activity rather than a molecular target.
limitations: Biofilm/persister activity is an outcome phenotype and should not be reported as a distinct molecular mechanism.
